headline: Kusumgar Limited provides clarification regarding its credit rating to the exchange
summary: Kusumgar Limited has submitted a regulatory filing to the stock exchange providing clarification on its credit rating. No further financial details or rating changes were disclosed in the brief announcement. The update is part of routine corporate compliance for listed entities. Indian retail investors have negligible exposure as this is a procedural micro-cap filing.
why_it_matters: Procedural compliance update with no financial impact.

headline: Kusumgar Limited submits depository participant certificate to NSE
hook: Routine compliance filing from Kusumgar Limited
summary: Kusumgar Limited has submitted a regulatory certificate to the stock exchange under SEBI regulations. This is a standard procedural compliance filing required for listed entities regarding depositories and participants. For Indian retail investors, this routine filing carries no direct financial or operational impact.
why_it_matters: No financial impact for retail shareholders.
